title: Launch: the item's uncommitted tracking edits on main are not in the worktree
lead: *Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. Size S. ork creates the worktree from the base branch's last commit. A slice spec that was promoted or edited on main but not committed is then missing from the worktree, while the spec check still reads it. This slice stops that silent mismatch at launch.
findings_note: S268 was promoted on main but not committed; its worktree lacked the spec and the landing stopped.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Evidence:

- `internal/engine/states.go:991` runs `git worktree add WT -b BRANCH` from the project's HEAD, so uncommitted files on main do not reach the worktree.
- On 2026-11-10, S268 was promoted on main (`slicer promote S268`, from `.scratch/s268-outline.md`) and not committed before `ork run ork S268`. The run went through. During the landing the worktree reported "S268: no slice spec; run slicer promote S268". The orchestrator committed `.slicer/slices/S268.json` on main, aborted the half-finished merge and ran `ork retry`.
- Adj 193 (`landing.tracking-commit`) lets ork commit uncommitted tracking edits on main before a landing (S254, `internal/engine/landdirty.go:113`, `checkMain`). Nothing like it runs at launch.
- Not verified: whether the implementer's brief reads the spec from main or from the worktree. The implementer must check this first and record it in the slice notes.

Open owner questions (the owner answers before the relay starts):
- Q1 what launch does when the item's own tracking files (`.slicer/slices/ID.json`, its render, `.slicer/index.json`) have uncommitted edits on main. (a) commit the `.slicer` tracking edits on main by path, as `checkMain` does at landing, then create the worktree (recommended: the same rule as adj 193, one step earlier; the commit message names the item). (b) refuse the launch with one line naming the files and the commit command. (c) warn and go on.
- Q2 does this need its own adj record, or does adj 193 cover launch. (a) a new record, key `launch.tracking-commit` (recommended: 193's text says "before a landing"). (b) 193 covers it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:27-52` (`setup`, tracking-error retry comment and pre-worktree commit); `internal/engine/states.go:1023` (`ensureWorktree`)
- `internal/engine/landdirty.go:86-197` (`trackingPath`, `splitTracking`, `commitLaunchTracking`, `checkMain`, shared `commitTracking`)
- `internal/engine/engine_test.go:59-145` (TestLaunchTracking tests, untracked item JSON and hook output assertion; existing setup assertion accepts pre-worktree status)
- `internal/engine/stop_test.go:120` (read-only-role worktree status assertion)
- `docs/design.md:391-400` (setup steps, absent-path condition and error handling)
- `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestLaunchTrackingItemOnly`: leave the item JSON untracked, with index and render tracked and edited; commit all three by literal path before worktree creation. Assert checkout contents and preserve unrelated staged tracking and notes. Include a subfolder project. Removing launch git add must fail.
- `TestLaunchTrackingNonTracking`: notes.txt stays uncommitted and launch succeeds without a commit.
- `TestLaunchTrackingClean`: clean main launches without a commit.
- `TestLaunchTrackingCommitFailure`: require the failing hook text including second line, a single-line reason, a setup pause and no worktree.

Brief source verified: `internal/engine/round.go:383` calls ShowRaw with rec.Worktree, then uses that JSON in BriefInput.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Before `worktree add`, list uncommitted paths on main (`git status --porcelain -z`). Keep the tracking ones with `splitTracking`.
2. Under Q1 (a), commit them by path, never with a pathspec of `.`, with the message `Tracking edits on main before starting ID`. A failed commit pauses with one line.
3. Docs (*proposed*): design.md's launch steps.
4. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased` (*proposed*).

- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` and `adj lint` exit 0; main-root check is orchestrator-only.
